sn2.4:1.2: Apparently the god “of Magadha”, although we meet no such deity elsewhere. Given that the Sutta follows the godling Māgha, and that PTS notes Māgha as a variant of this name in Sinhala manuscripts, perhaps this is a misspelling of Maghada, “giver of bounty”. Cf. Rig Vedic _maghadeya_ (7.67.9), _indro maghāni dayate_ (7.21.7). See also note on next Sutta.
